sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:8

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:8:1
items.html: New vessels through this clothing, etc., and from these two kinds of vessels, the Partzuf ZA was made: That is, they are vessels of MA and vessels of BON. For all the new vessels that come out with the couplings made in Atzilut are called vessels of MA. And the vessels that remained in ZAT from the time of Nekudim are called vessels of BON. And these two kinds of vessels are found in all the five Partzufim of Atzilut.
